lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Tuesday's Town Council meeting, where the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code goes to its third and final reading — passage would amend Telluride's Land Use Code on historic review standards and landscaping rules in ways that touch nearly every property owner in town. Ridgway's council also has a full plate Wednesday, with a public hearing on the Hyde Subdivision resubdivision and a joint work session on the draft 2026 Housing Action Plan. Meanwhile, the Mushroom Festival rolls into the valley mid-week and the Open Space Commission heads out to Bear Creek Monday afternoon to scout a new trail alignment.

notable.stake: Final vote on wildfire code that rewrites land-use and landscaping rules for property owners.
Public hearing on Hyde Subdivision resubdivision and housing action plan with open input opportunity.
County energy code update and subdivision mechanics review could reshape new construction standards.
